verdict.rationale: Puzzle has a dedicated /accountants page emphasizing accountant collaboration, real-time reports, and QuickBooks migration for accountants, implying multi-user access, but there's no explicit documentation of an invite flow or role-scoped permissions for external bookkeepers. missing for 10: explicit invite/role-based access controls, permission-scoping details, and any hands-on confirmation of accountant-specific login/roles.
